sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017: sparse mixture-of-experts model with 1M context window DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a sparse mixture-of-experts model built on the company's Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture, activating 8B parameters on input and 16B on output from a 552B-parameter backbone.

sources.snippet: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is a multimodal model for reasoning, coding, and long-context agents, with native image input, a 1M-token context window, and improved performance over the original V4.1 Flash.
